name: infographic
description: one original, sourced 4K editorial infographic, inspected and owner-approved

stages.name: intake
stages.exit: operator content, audience and language are explicit; orientation is resolved

stages.name: design
stages.exit: source snapshots, claim provenance, central message, visual grammar and reading order pass checks

stages.name: produce
stages.exit: SDK-authored scene strictly renders one 4K PNG; local assets and source package are verified

stages.name: review
stages.exit: the exact full, half and quarter-size frames were inspected; issues fixed and editorial scores pass

stages.name: approval
stages.exit: owner approves the complete candidate by its SHA-256

stages.name: deliver
stages.exit: PNG and reproducible package match the reviewed and explicitly approved candidate

gates.name: final
gates.message: the owner must inspect the complete candidate and quote its SHA-256
